#!/bin/sh
# Run only through cable-connected, host-bounded SSH after scoped approval.
# No document contents, general settings, private library listings, or unrestricted journal.
set -eu
printf 'FIRMWARE\n'
cat /etc/os-release
printf 'TOOLS\n'
for executable in sha256sum systemctl systemd-run find ls cat sh sleep cp rm chmod mkdir readlink; do
    command -v "$executable"
done
printf 'STOCK_AND_LOADER\n'
sha256sum /usr/bin/xochitl /home/root/xovi/xovi.so /home/root/xovi/start /home/root/xovi/stock
printf 'EXTENSIONS\n'
find /home/root/xovi/extensions.d -maxdepth 1 -type f -exec sha256sum {} \;
ls -l /home/root/xovi/extensions.d
printf 'SERVICE\n'
systemctl cat xochitl
systemctl show xochitl -p FragmentPath -p DropInPaths -p Environment
systemctl is-active xochitl
printf 'LISTENERS\n'
cat /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6
printf 'USB_CONTROLLERS\n'
for state in /sys/class/udc/*/state; do
    printf '%s ' "$state"
    cat "$state"
done
printf 'PATH_COLLISIONS\n'
for path in /home/root/xovi/extensions.d/pi-ink-loopback-experiment.so /home/root/pi-ink-loopback-0014; do
    test ! -e "$path"
    test ! -L "$path"
done
